title: Bertoni 2026 · Experiment 2 · Clinical bedside EEG
citation: Bertoni, T., Ricci, G., Jöhr, J., et al. (2026). Multisensory integration in peripersonal space indexes consciousness states in sleep and disorders of consciousness. Cell Reports Medicine, 7(4), 102705.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.response: Primary outcome comes from synchronized passive EEG. No overt trial response is required.
published_method.index: Contrast auditory near minus auditory far with audio-tactile near minus audio-tactile far, using poststimulus high-beta power (20–30 Hz).
published_method.stimulus: Present 50 ms white noise at 5 cm or 75 cm from the arm. Pair with a nominal 50 ms, 35 Hz FES train near the elbow over extensor digitorum communis, set to 70% of the observed motor threshold.
published_method.clinical_follow_up: Relate the high-beta index to CRS-R scores, cognitive motor dissociation grouping, discharge outcome, and separately acquired MRI where available.

implementation_gaps: The bedside branch requires a clinically operated FES stimulator and calibrated arm-relative speakers synchronized to EEG. Candidate playback cannot establish physical equivalence.
Implement acquisition and outcome scoring for clinical EEG, CRS-R and discharge measures, and verify the preprocessing and 16-channel high-beta aggregation.
Verify exact FES pulse shape/count, stimulus synchronization and the block-order and intertrial-timing realizations.
